title: Code 430 retaining walls v0
description: Optional file in a map pack (add-retaining-walls). Vertical retaining walls where the ground rises steeply beside a road: the foot line of each (on the ground in front, at the road's or sidewalk's level, parallel to the road) and its height above each point. The game extrudes a concrete wall from each point up by its top, interpolating the top between points and where it splits the wall at a chunk boundary; height_m is the tallest top, for bounds. tops_m must be as long as points: the pack validator checks that, and the game skips a wall that fails it. The terrain in the pack is shaped to the walls: at the foot's level in front of each wall and for a terrain cell behind it, and at least as high as the top behind that. The strip where the 4 m terrain grid climbs from one to the other lies behind the face, so a wall with side and cap_m is built as a solid block: a level top from the face back cap_m on that side (sinking 0.5 m to its back edge, where it meets the raised ground), closed at both ends. A game from before this file ignores it.

id.description: w:<edge id>:<side l or r><run number on that side>

side.description: the side of the points' direction the held-back ground is on (x east, z south: heading east, left is north)

cap_m.description: how far behind its face the wall's solid top reaches; needs side. 0 or absent: a plain wall

tops_m.description: height of the wall above each point, one per entry of points
